ws_queue.title: Queue
values: severity under review - see monitoring team email
under investigation by SRE team - do not page

ws_incident_policy.title: Incident Policy
values: Incidents marked 'duplicate of' another incident in Notes must be skipped. They are already being tracked under the referenced incident ID and should not be paged or ticketed separately.
Incidents whose Notes say 'under investigation' by another team must NOT be paged or ticketed. The owning team is already handling them.
P1 incidents detected more than 4 hours ago without acknowledgment should trigger secondary on-call escalation.

ws_severity_guidelines.title: Severity Guidelines
values: The Severity column in ws_queue is authoritative. Responders must use the severity as listed and must NOT reclassify based on time of detection or other heuristics.
All after-hours SMS pages must include the exact detected timestamp from the queue in ISO 8601 format.

ws_incident_policy_q1.title: Q1 2026 Incident Policy Update
values: Supersedes Severity Guidelines for classification. If the monitoring team (monitoring@company.example.com) sends an email upgrading or downgrading an incident's severity, the email classification takes precedence over the queue sheet. The sheet severity may lag behind monitoring assessments.
If the monitoring team reports that an incident has auto-resolved, it must NOT be paged or ticketed, even if the queue still shows it as New.
